resources.string: Use the OTG port for accessories or to connect to a computer
The OTG port acts as a device for a computer
The OTG port powers accessories like pads, drives and network adapters

Turn this on to reach the console from a computer through the OTG port: file transfer (MTP) or photo transfer (PTP), and adb once USB debugging is on in Developer options.

While it is on, accessories plugged into the OTG port don't work. The console always starts with it off, a restart switches the port back to accessories.

Some consoles don't wire the port for this. If the computer sees nothing with a good data cable, the console can't do it.

Never turn this on if your console has Wi-Fi built in, such as the R36XX. Those consoles use this same USB port for their Wi-Fi.

Never use this while the console is charging from its other port. Unplug the charger first. If a charger is plugged in while this is on, the port switches back to accessories right away.

Don\'t turn this on if your console has Wi-Fi built in, such as the R36XX. Those consoles use this same USB port for their Wi-Fi. Wi-Fi stops working, may not come back until you restart, and other things can go wrong.\n\nMost R36S consoles have no Wi-Fi built in. On those, this is safe.
